_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture — assembled from public Spreed source, not captured from a real server. Verify against real traffic in Task 2.3. Represents ONE incoming 'candidate' (trickle ICE) message as delivered by the long-poll GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v3/signaling/{token}. Envelope shape identical to offer/answer; payload carries a single ICE candidate. Per pion/webrtc perfect-negotiation usage (spec §7), such candidates may arrive BEFORE the offer/answer; the call/peer layer must buffer them until SetRemoteDescription. Two records are shown: a 'host' candidate (TEST-NET-3 IP 203.0.113.10) and an 'srflx' candidate (TEST-NET-3 IP 198.51.100.20 from a STUN reflex). Anonymized: sessionId -> 'SESSION_1'/'SESSION_2'; public ICE IPs -> RFC 5737 TEST-NET-1/2 (192.0.2.x / 198.51.100.x) and TEST-NET-3 (203.0.113.x); port numbers synthetic.
